definition_zh: 点；小圆点；小数点；加点；点缀；准时
definition_en: a small round mark, the decimal point, to mark or spread over an area, or exactly on time
core_image: 地图上几个墨点，把散落的村庄连成一条路
scene: 地图上的村庄只剩几个墨点，山路细得像线。The child joined the dots to draw a house.
sceneCN: 这里 dot 是「小圆点」（第 1 个义项：用笔点出或印在纸上的小圆痕）；句意是孩子把那些点连起来画成了一座房子。

pos.zh: 点；小圆点；小数点
加点；点缀；散布

collocations.zh: 给字母 i 加点；把细节弄妥

senses.title: A small round mark
senses.definition: a small round mark made with a pen or printed on a surface
senses.definitionCN: 用笔点出或印在表面的小圆痕
senses.example: Each village is marked with a red dot.
senses.exampleCN: 每个村庄都用一个小红点标出。
senses.why: The earliest sense is the visible speck itself, the smallest mark a pen can leave.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是那个看得见的小痕，是笔能留下的最小记号。

senses.title: The decimal point
senses.definition: the mark used in British English to separate a whole number from its fraction
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中用来分隔整数与小数的记号
senses.example: Write the answer as four point five, with a dot between them.
senses.exampleCN: 把答案写成四点五，中间加一个小数点。
senses.why: A decimal point is literally a dot, so British usage simply calls the mark by its shape.
senses.whyCN: 小数点本来就是一个小圆点，英式用法干脆按形状来称呼这个记号。

senses.title: To mark or spread with dots
senses.definition: to mark something with small round marks, or to be spread over an area in separate places
senses.definitionCN: 用小圆痕标记某物，或分散地散布在一片区域上
senses.example: Small farms dot the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 小农场散布在山坡上。
senses.why: The noun turns into an action: placing dots turns into covering an area with separate small things.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成动作：一个一个点的摆放，变成在一片区域散布许多小东西。

senses.title: Exactly on time
senses.definition: used in the phrase on the dot to mean at exactly the stated time
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 on the dot，表示正好在所说的时刻
senses.example: The train left at nine on the dot.
senses.exampleCN: 火车九点整开走了。
senses.why: A clock face marks each minute with a dot, so arriving on the dot means landing exactly on that mark.
senses.whyCN: 钟面上每一分钟都由一个点标出，因此 on the dot 就是正好落在那个点上。

intro.en: Dot is a word of uncertain origin, first recorded in English in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: dot 来源不确定，在英语中最早于十七世纪有记录。

items.en: The word appears in the seventeenth century; no earlier history is securely established.
items.cn: 这个词在十七世纪出现，更早的历史没有可靠结论。

items.en: One common suggestion compares Dutch dot, a knot or small bunch, but this is not proven.
items.cn: 一种常见说法把它与荷兰语 dot（结、小团）相比，但未获证实。

items.en: Early uses name a small mark or a speck on a surface.
items.cn: 早期用法指表面上的小记号或小斑点。

items.en: The verb to dot and the phrase on the dot both became common.
items.cn: 动词 dot 与短语 on the dot 都在这时通行起来。

items.en: Dotted lines and polka dots entered sewing, printing and fashion.
items.cn: 点线与波点在缝纫、印刷与时尚中使用。

items.en: The internet added dot-com, where the dot is the one in a web address.
items.cn: 互联网时代又加上 dot-com，这里的点是网址中的那个点。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dot stem; the near-meaning group gathers other small marks.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dot 词干；近义组收的是其他小记号。

entries.definition: Marked with dots or made of dots, as a dotted line.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「带点的、点状的」，如点线。

entries.definition: Informal British word for slightly crazy or eccentric.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，英式口语，义为「有点古怪的、不大清醒的」。

entries.definition: An internet company, named after the dot in a web address.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「网络公司」，得名于网址中的点。

entries.definition: A sharp end or a particular position; also a mark in space.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「点、位置、尖端」，也指空间中的标记，范围更广。

entries.definition: A round mark that is usually larger or less regular than a dot.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「斑点」，通常比 dot 更大或更不规则。

entries.definition: A very small piece or mark of dirt or colour.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「微粒、小污点」，指极小的脏物或颜色痕迹。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real uncertain history and the places dots actually appear.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用真实的来源不确定之说，以及点实际出现的场合。

normal.en: Dot has no proven origin; Dutch dot is only a comparison, not a source.
normal.cn: dot 没有已证实的来源，荷兰语 dot 只是比较，不是定论。

normal.en: A decimal point is called a dot in British usage because of its shape.
normal.cn: 小数点英式称 dot，就是因为它的形状。

normal.en: On the dot means on the exact minute mark of a clock.
normal.cn: on the dot 指正好落在钟面的那一分钟刻度上。

normal.en: Polka dots are round marks repeated all over a fabric.
normal.cn: 波点就是布满布面的重复圆点。

normal.en: Farms that dot a hillside look like separate marks on a map.
normal.cn: 散布在山坡上的农场，看起来就像地图上的一个个点。

abstract.en: Picture one drop of ink falling on paper and staying round.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴墨落在纸上，保持着圆形。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of dots that a pencil turns into an outline.
abstract.cn: 想象一张点阵纸，被铅笔画出一条轮廓。

abstract.en: Picture a clock hand landing exactly on a tiny mark.
abstract.cn: 想象钟面的指针正好落在一个小点上。

examples.en: Put a dot beside the correct answer.
examples.cn: 在正确答案旁边点一个点。

examples.en: The valley is dotted with small stone houses.
examples.cn: 山谷里散布着一座座石头小屋。

examples.en: She arrived at eight on the dot.
examples.cn: 她八点整到了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「大特」——笔尖在纸上特地点一下，留下一个特别小的圆痕，就是 dot。

root: dot 于十七世纪出现于英语，来源不确定；荷兰语 dot（结、小团）只是常被拿来比较的形式，不能确定为来源。早期指表面上的小记号，后产生动词「加点、散布」义与 on the dot（准时）等说法。

sensesIntro.en: One small mark becomes a decimal point, a way of spreading things over a map, and a clock mark for punctuality.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个小记号，变成小数点、在地图上散布事物的方式，以及衡量准时的钟面刻度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a few ink dots that a line of pencil joins into a shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：几个墨点被铅笔线连成一个形状。

branches.en: THE MARK: the first sense is the visible speck made by a pen.
branches.cn: 记号线：第一个义项是笔留下的可见小痕。

branches.en: THE DECIMAL: the second sense is the same shape used in numbers.
branches.cn: 小数线：第二个义项是同一形状用在数字里。

branches.en: THE SCATTER: the third sense spreads small marks across a whole area.
branches.cn: 散布线：第三个义项把许多小记号铺到一整片区域。

branches.en: THE MINUTE: the fourth sense uses the clock's dots to mean exactness.
branches.cn: 分刻线：第四个义项用钟面上的点表示精确。

branches.en: A single dot and a landscape full of dots are the same shape seen close and far.
branches.cn: 单个点与满布景色的点，是同一形状的近看与远看。

intro.en: Dot has no Latin root; its family is built with English suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: dot 没有拉丁词根，它的小词族靠英语后缀与复合构成。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognate of dot is known, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: dot 没有已知的拉丁同族词，所以拉丁条目留空。

definition_zh: n. 落水管；降液管；下降管；下行风道
definition_en: a pipe or channel that carries liquid or air downward, especially from a roof gutter or between trays in a column
core_image: 屋檐沟槽接出一根竖直白管，雨水顺管直落地面溅起水花；蒸馏塔里液体从上一层塔板沿管流到下一层；锅炉外侧一根粗管向下送水
scene: 屋檐的排水沟接出一根竖直的白管，雨水顺着它直落到地面。Rainwater runs straight down the downcomer from the gutter to the ground.
sceneCN: 这里 downcomer 是「落水管」（第 1 个义项：把屋顶雨水从檐沟竖直引到地面的管子）；句意是雨水顺着落水管从檐沟一直流到地面。图中可辨识物件：檐沟、竖直白管、管卡、地面水花。

pos.zh: 落水管；降液管；下降管；下行风道

senses.title: Roof rainwater pipe
senses.definition: a vertical pipe that carries rainwater from a roof gutter to the ground
senses.definitionCN: （名词）把屋顶雨水从檐沟竖直引到地面的管子
senses.example: Rainwater runs straight down the downcomer to the ground.
senses.exampleCN: 雨水顺着落水管一直流到地面。
senses.why: A white vertical pipe clipped to a wall, water splashing at its foot.
senses.whyCN: 一根用管卡固定在墙上的白色竖管，管脚溅起水花。

senses.title: Liquid channel in a column
senses.definition: a channel that lets liquid flow from one tray to the tray below in a distillation column
senses.definitionCN: （名词）蒸馏塔中让液体从上一层塔板流到下一层的通道
senses.example: The downcomer between the two trays was blocked.
senses.exampleCN: 两层塔板之间的降液管堵了。
senses.why: Liquid leaving the top tray of a tower and sliding down a pipe to the next tray.
senses.whyCN: 液体离开塔的上层塔板，沿一根管滑到下一层。

senses.title: Boiler water tube
senses.definition: a tube that carries cooler water down from a steam drum to the lower headers of a boiler
senses.definitionCN: （名词）锅炉中把较冷的水从汽包向下送到下集箱的管子
senses.example: Cooler water returns through the downcomer tubes.
senses.exampleCN: 较冷的水通过下降管回流。
senses.why: A thick pipe running down the outside of a boiler while steam rises inside.
senses.whyCN: 一根粗管沿锅炉外侧向下走，蒸汽在内部上升。

senses.title: Downward air duct
senses.definition: a duct that carries air or gas downward in a mine or building
senses.definitionCN: （名词）矿井或建筑中把空气或气体向下输送的风道
senses.example: The downcomer brings fresh air to the lower level.
senses.exampleCN: 下行风道把新鲜空气送到下一层。
senses.why: A wide shaft with an arrow of air pointing down into a lower floor.
senses.whyCN: 一条宽井道，一股气流箭头指向下面一层。

intro.en: Downcomer is down plus come plus -er, the thing that comes down; it is a modern engineering compound rather than an old inherited word, and it names any pipe whose job is to carry something downward.
intro.cn: downcomer 由 down 加 come 加 -er 组成，就是「往下走的东西」；它是现代工程复合词，不是古已有之的继承词，用来指任何专职把东西向下送的管子。

items.en: Old English dune means down or downward.
items.cn: 古英语 dune 意为向下。

items.en: Old English cuman means to come.
items.cn: 古英语 cuman 意为来。

items.en: The suffix -er names the thing that does the action.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 指做这个动作的东西。

items.en: The compound is used for a pipe carrying rainwater down.
items.cn: 这个复合词被用于把雨水向下送的管子。

items.en: Engineers use downcomer for the liquid channel between trays.
items.cn: 工程师用 downcomer 指塔板之间的液体通道。

items.en: The same word names the tube carrying water down from a steam drum.
items.cn: 同一个词也指把水从汽包向下送的管子。

note.en: Downcomer is the thing that comes down; its look-alikes share down, and its neighbours name the other pipes in the same water path.
note.cn: downcomer 是往下走的东西；形近词共用 down，近义词则是同一条水路里的其他管子。

dict_mnemonic.text: downcomer ＝ down（向下）＋ come（来）＋ -er（做…的东西）＝「往下走的东西」。屋顶上它是落水管，蒸馏塔里它是让液体流到下一层塔板的降液管，锅炉里它是把冷水送下去的下降管。英式落水管也说 downpipe，美式说 downspout。

root: 古英语 dune（向下）＋ cuman（来）＋ -er（施事后缀）→ 现代工程复合词 downcomer（下行管）

sensesIntro.en: One pipe whose job is to carry something down: roof rainwater, liquid between trays, boiler water and air to a lower floor.
sensesIntro.cn: 一根专职向下送东西的管子：屋顶雨水、塔板间的液体、锅炉的水与送到下一层的空气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white vertical pipe clipped to a wall with rainwater splashing at its foot beside a tower tray feeding the tray below

branches.en: Liquid passed from one tray to the next.
branches.cn: 从一层塔板传到下一层的液体。

branches.en: Cool water sent down inside a boiler.
branches.cn: 锅炉内向下送的冷水。

branches.en: Air pushed down to a lower level.
branches.cn: 向下送到下一层的空气。

branches.en: Both are water moving down a pipe.
branches.cn: 两者都是水沿管向下走。

intro.en: Downcomer is down plus come plus -er; the same -er builds riser from rise, while the Latin roots duct- and plumb- name leading and pipes from another direction.
intro.cn: downcomer 由 down 加 come 加 -er 构成；同一个 -er 从 rise 造出 riser，而拉丁语词根 duct- 与 plumb- 从另一个方向指称引导与管子。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere means to lead, plumbum lead metal and canalis a channel; imber means a rain storm.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ducere 意为引导，plumbum 意为铅，canalis 意为沟渠；imber 意为暴雨。

definition_zh: n. 垮台；衰败；祸根；堕落；（旧）暴雨，大雪
definition_en: a sudden loss of power or position, the thing that causes ruin, or a heavy fall of rain
core_image: 王座上的雕像从基座翻落摔碎；一根被抽掉的支柱让整排架子塌下；一片乌云把整桶雨水倒在山谷上
scene: 王座上的雕像从基座翻落，在台阶上摔成几块。The statue toppled from its pedestal, a fitting image of the downfall of the regime.
sceneCN: 这里 downfall 是「垮台」（第 1 个义项：统治者或政权突然失去权力与地位）；句意是雕像从基座翻落，正好是这个政权垮台的写照。图中可辨识物件：王座基座、翻落的雕像、碎裂的石块、台阶。

pos.zh: 垮台；衰败；祸根；堕落；（旧）暴雨，大雪

senses.title: Loss of power
senses.definition: the sudden loss of power or position by a ruler or government
senses.definitionCN: （名词）统治者或政府突然失去权力或地位
senses.example: The scandal led to the downfall of the minister.
senses.exampleCN: 丑闻导致这位部长垮台。
senses.why: A statue toppling from its pedestal and breaking on the steps.
senses.whyCN: 一座雕像从基座翻落，在台阶上摔碎。

senses.title: The cause of ruin
senses.definition: the thing that causes someone to fail or be ruined
senses.definitionCN: （名词）导致某人失败或毁灭的事物
senses.example: Greed proved to be his downfall.
senses.exampleCN: 贪婪成了他的祸根。
senses.why: One support knocked out from under a loaded shelf.
senses.whyCN: 满载架子下被抽掉的一根支柱。

senses.title: A moral fall
senses.definition: a fall from a high moral state into wrongdoing
senses.definitionCN: （名词）从高尚的道德状态跌入恶行
senses.example: The novel traces the downfall of an honest man.
senses.exampleCN: 小说追溯了一个诚实人的堕落。
senses.why: A white robe dragged through mud until it is grey.
senses.whyCN: 一件白袍被拖过泥地，直到变成灰色。

senses.title: A heavy fall of rain
senses.definition: a heavy fall of rain or snow, in older or literary use
senses.definitionCN: （名词）旧时或文学用法中指雨或雪的大量降落
senses.example: A sudden downfall of rain flooded the yard.
senses.exampleCN: 一场骤降的大雨淹了院子。
senses.why: A cloud tipping a whole bucket of water over a valley.
senses.whyCN: 一片乌云把整桶水倒在山谷上。

intro.en: Downfall is down plus fall, a falling down; it first named a literal drop, then the drop of a ruler from power, and in older writing a heavy fall of rain.
intro.cn: downfall 由 down 加 fall 组成，就是「往下落」；它先指实际的坠落，再指统治者从权位上跌落，旧时文字里也指雨的大量降落。

items.en: Old English dune means down or downward.
items.cn: 古英语 dune 意为向下。

items.en: Old English feallan means to fall.
items.cn: 古英语 feallan 意为落下。

items.en: Middle English downfall names a literal falling down.
items.cn: 中古英语 downfall 指实际的坠落。

items.en: The word is used for a ruler losing position.
items.cn: 这个词被用于统治者失去权位。

items.en: Writers use downfall for a heavy fall of rain or snow.
items.cn: 作者用 downfall 指雨或雪的大量降落。

items.en: Downfall now most often names ruin or the cause of ruin.
items.cn: downfall 现在最常指垮台或导致垮台的原因。

note.en: Downfall is a falling down; its look-alikes share down or fall, and its neighbours name other ways a high position ends.
note.cn: downfall 是往下落；形近词共用 down 或 fall，近义词则是高位终结的其他方式。

dict_mnemonic.text: downfall ＝ down（向下）＋ fall（落下）＝「往下落」。先是实际的坠落，再是统治者从权位上跌落，即垮台；也指把人拖垮的那件事，即祸根。旧时文字里还指雨的大量降落，今天这个意思多用 downpour。

root: 古英语 dune（向下）＋ feallan（落下）→ 中古英语 downfall（坠落）→ 现代 downfall（垮台；祸根；旧指暴雨）

definition_zh: adj. 沮丧的；垂头丧气的；气馁的
definition_en: sad and without hope or energy, especially after a setback
core_image: 一个人坐在长椅边，肩塌着、头低着，手里的信纸垂向地面；雨后一只耷拉着翅膀的鸟
scene: 他坐在长椅边上，肩膀塌着，头低低垂向手里的信纸。He looked downhearted as he read the letter for the third time.
sceneCN: 这里 downhearted 是「垂头丧气的」（第 1 个义项：悲伤、没有希望也没有力气）；句意是他第三遍读那封信时显得垂头丧气。图中可辨识物件：长椅、塌下的肩、低垂的头、垂向地面的信纸。

pos.zh: 沮丧的；垂头丧气的；气馁的

senses.title: Low in spirits
senses.definition: feeling sad and without hope or energy
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）感到悲伤、没有希望也没有力气

senses.title: Discouraged by a setback

senses.title: Showing low spirits

senses.exampleCN: 她沮丧地笑了笑，什么也没说。
senses.why: A bird with wings hanging loose after the rain, unable to lift them.
senses.whyCN: 雨后一只翅膀耷拉着的鸟，抬不起来。

intro.en: Downhearted is down plus hearted, with the heart sunk down; English has long placed feeling in the heart, so a heart that has dropped is a spirit that has dropped with it.
intro.cn: downhearted 由 down 加 hearted 组成，心沉了下去；英语长久以来把情感放在心里，所以心一沉，精神也跟着沉。

items.en: Old English heorte means the heart.
items.cn: 古英语 heorte 意为心脏。

items.en: Old English dune means down or downward.
items.cn: 古英语 dune 意为向下。

items.en: Middle English herted means having a heart of a kind.
items.cn: 中古英语 herted 意为有某种心的。

items.en: English builds light-hearted and faint-hearted on the same pattern.
items.cn: 英语按同一格式造出 light-hearted 与 faint-hearted。

items.en: Downhearted is recorded for low spirits after a setback.
items.cn: downhearted 被记录下来，指受挫后情绪低落。

items.en: The word stays informal and describes a temporary mood.
items.cn: 这个词保持非正式色彩，描述一时的情绪。

note.en: Downhearted is a heart sunk down; its look-alikes share the hearted pattern, and its neighbours name nearby shades of low feeling.
note.cn: downhearted 是心沉了下去；形近词共用 hearted 格式，近义词则是低落情绪的邻近层次。

core_image: 一个文件夹图标沿箭头从云端落到桌面；笔记本上的进度条一格格填满；一个高柜把内容倒进桌上的小盒子
scene: 笔记本屏幕上的进度条一格格填满，文件正从远处的服务器落到本地硬盘。She waited for the file to download before leaving the office.
sceneCN: 这里 download 是「下载」（第 1 个义项：把文件从远端系统复制到自己的设备上）；句意是她等文件下载完才离开办公室。图中可辨识物件：笔记本、进度条、服务器机柜、办公室门。

senses.title: Copy to your device

senses.why: A progress bar filling one block at a time under a spinning circle.

intro.en: Download is down plus load, a load brought down; it grew out of 1970s computing, where moving data from a large central machine to a smaller local one was pictured as bringing a load down from above.
intro.cn: download 由 down 加 load 组成，把一份负荷带下来；它产生于 1970 年代的计算机领域，当时把数据从大型中央机器移到较小的本地机器，被想象成从上方把负荷搬下来。

intro.en: Downpour is down plus pour, rain poured down; the compound is first recorded in the 19th century and replaced older phrases such as a downfall of rain.
intro.cn: downpour 由 down 加 pour 组成，雨被倒下来；这个复合词最早见于 19 世纪，取代了 a downfall of rain 一类旧说法。

items.en: Old English dune means down or downward.

items.en: Middle English pouren means to pour, of unknown origin.
items.cn: 中古英语 pouren 意为倒，来源不明。

items.en: English pour is used for liquid flowing out in a stream.
items.cn: 英语 pour 用于液体成股流出。

items.en: The compound downpour is recorded for a heavy fall of rain.

items.en: Downpour becomes the standard word in forecasts.
items.cn: downpour 成为天气预报中的标准用词。

items.en: The word is also used figuratively for a flood of things.

note.en: Downpour is rain poured down; its look-alikes share down or pour, and its neighbours name other kinds of wet weather.

intro.en: Downsize is down plus size, to make the size go down; it is a 20th century business compound that became common in the 1980s and 1990s as firms cut staff.

definition_en: a group of twelve, or a roughly counted group of about that size

scene: 烘焙课开始前，老师把鸡蛋摆上台面，让学生数清楚每盘的数量。We need a dozen eggs for the cake.
sceneCN: 这里 dozen 是「一打、十二个」（第 1 个义项）；句意是做这个蛋糕我们需要一打鸡蛋。

senses.title: A group of twelve
senses.definition: a set of twelve things, especially eggs, bread rolls, or bottles
senses.definitionCN: 十二个一组的东西，尤指鸡蛋、面包或瓶子
senses.example: She bought a dozen eggs at the market.
senses.exampleCN: 她在市场上买了一打鸡蛋。
senses.why: Old French dozeine was built on douze, twelve, from Latin duodecim, so the word simply carries the number twelve inside it.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 dozeine 由 douze（十二）构成，而 douze 又来自拉丁语 duodecim，所以这个词本身就把「十二」装在里面。

senses.title: A large but approximate number
senses.definition: a large number of people or things, used loosely rather than exactly
senses.definitionCN: 大量的人或物，只是约略说法，并非精确计数
senses.example: Dozens of volunteers turned up before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 天还没亮就来了几十名志愿者。
senses.why: Because a dozen is a handy bundle, the plural dozens slid into the general sense of many.
senses.whyCN: 因为「一打」是一个顺手的打包单位，复数 dozens 就顺势滑向「许多」这个泛指。

senses.title: Used as a counting word before a noun
senses.definition: placed before a plural noun to count things in twelves
senses.definitionCN: 放在复数名词前，按十二个一组来计数
senses.example: The bakery sells two dozen rolls every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 这家面包店每天早上卖出两打小面包。
senses.why: English keeps dozen unmarked after a number, so it works like a measuring word rather than an ordinary plural noun.
senses.whyCN: 英语里 dozen 跟在数词后不加 -s，因此它像量词一样使用，而不像普通可数名词。

intro.en: Dozen came through Old French from Latin duodecim, literally two and ten.
intro.cn: dozen 经古法语来自拉丁语 duodecim，字面是「二加十」。

items.en: The numeral two goes back to a root meaning two, and ten to a root meaning ten.
items.cn: 数词「二」可追溯到表示二的词根，「十」也有自己的古老词根。

items.en: Duodecim combined duo, two, and decem, ten, to name twelve.
items.cn: duodecim 把 duo（二）与 decem（十）合起来，表示十二。

items.en: Dozeine, from douze, named a set of twelve and was used for goods sold in bundles.
items.cn: dozeine 由 douze（十二）派生，指十二个一组，用于成捆出售的货物。

items.en: English borrowed the word as dozen and applied it first to bread and eggs; precise dating is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语借入作 dozen，最早多用于面包和鸡蛋；精确年代不确定。

items.en: The plural dozens took on the loose sense of many, and fixed phrases such as baker's dozen appeared.
items.cn: 复数 dozens 发展出「许多」的宽泛义，也出现了 baker's dozen 这类固定说法。

note.en: The look-alike group consists of number words and derived forms; the near-meaning group names other quantities.

intro.cn: dozen 是整体借来的词，它的构件是拉丁数词，而不是活的英语词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin duo and decem combine in duodecim, and Old French reshaped it into douze and dozeine.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 duo 与 decem 合成 duodecim，古法语又把它塑造成 douze 与 dozeine。

items.example: Duo is the first half of twelve.
Decem is the second half of twelve.
The Latin numeral is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁数词是直接来源。

items.example: French kept the numeral after the noun was borrowed.
items.exampleCN: 法语在名词借出后仍保留这个数词。
这个名词变成了英语的 dozen。

derivatives.zh: 由 dozen 加 -th 构成，义为「第十二的」

definition_en: a first rough version of a text, or a current of air, or to write an early version
core_image: 纸上涂改满篇的第一稿，还留着未定形的线条
scene: 会议室里，几个人围着打印稿争论措辞，纸上还画着箭头。She finished the first draft of the report at midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 draft 是「草稿」（第 1 个义项）；句意是她半夜完成了报告的初稿。

senses.title: A first rough version of a text
senses.definition: an early version of a piece of writing, not yet finished or approved
senses.definitionCN: 文字作品尚未完成或未获批准的早期版本
senses.example: He sent me a rough draft of his speech.
senses.exampleCN: 他把演讲的粗稿发给我。
senses.why: The word first meant something pulled or drawn out, so a draft is the part of a text pulled out from the mind before it sets.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早表示「被拉出来、画出来的东西」，所以草稿就是从脑子里先拉出来的那一部分文字，尚未定型。

senses.title: A plan not yet final
senses.definition: a written plan or proposal that still has to be discussed and approved
senses.definitionCN: 尚待讨论与批准的书面计划或提案
senses.example: The committee rejected the draft budget.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会否决了预算草案。
senses.why: A budget also starts as a drawn outline before it becomes binding, so the same word covers any unfinished plan.
senses.whyCN: 预算同样先有一个画出来的框架，之后才变得有约束力，因此同一个词也指任何未定案的计划。

senses.title: An order to pay money
senses.definition: a written order asking a bank to pay a sum of money to a named person
senses.definitionCN: 要求银行向指定的人支付一笔款项的书面指令
senses.example: The buyer paid by bank draft.
senses.exampleCN: 买家以银行汇票付款。
senses.why: A payment order is also a drawn writing, a document pulled out of an account, so banking borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 付款指令也是一种「画出来的文书」，是从账户里拉出的一纸凭证，于是银行沿用了同一个词。

senses.title: A current of air in a room
senses.definition: a stream of cool air that comes through a window or a gap
senses.definitionCN: 从窗户或缝隙进来的冷气流
senses.example: A cold draft came under the door.
senses.exampleCN: 一股冷风从门底下钻进来。
senses.why: This sense is a separate English word for pulling, because air is literally drawn or pulled through a gap.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个英语词，本义是「拉、拖」，因为风正是被从缝隙里拉进来的。

senses.title: To write an early version
senses.definition: to write the first version of a letter, speech, or plan
senses.definitionCN: 写出信件、演讲或计划的第一个版本
senses.example: They asked her to draft the reply.
senses.exampleCN: 他们请她起草回信。
senses.why: Since a draft is the pulled-out version, the verb simply names the act of producing that version.
senses.whyCN: 既然草稿是「先拉出来的那一版」，动词自然就是「把那一版写出来」这个动作。

senses.title: To call people into military service
senses.definition: to order people to join the armed forces or to move staff to another job
senses.definitionCN: 命令人们入伍，或把人员调去别的岗位
senses.example: He was drafted into the army at nineteen.
senses.exampleCN: 他十九岁时被征召入伍。
senses.why: People are pulled out of ordinary life the way a plan is pulled out of the mind, so the same verb serves military service.
senses.whyCN: 人被从日常生活中「拉走」，正如计划从脑子里被拉出来，于是同一个动词也用于征兵。

intro.en: Draft and draught are the same word in two spellings, and both go back to a verb meaning to draw or pull.
intro.cn: draft 与 draught 是同一个词的两种拼写，都可追溯到表示「拉、画」的动词。

items.en: Dragan meant to draw or pull and is the ancestor of modern draw.
items.cn: 古英语 dragan 意为「拉、拖、画」，是现代 draw 的祖先。

items.en: Draught named the act of drawing, and then the thing drawn, such as a written outline.
items.cn: draught 指「拉、画」的动作，后来指被画出的东西，例如一份文字框架。

items.en: The spelling draft became usual for written versions and for banking orders.
items.cn: 拼写 draft 逐渐固定用于文字版本与银行票据。

items.en: Military drafting developed the sense of pulling people into service.
items.cn: 军事上的征兵用法发展出「把人拉去服役」的意思。

items.en: In Britain draught is kept for air and drinks, while draft dominates in America for most senses.
items.cn: 英式英语用 draught 指气流与饮品，美式英语则在多数义项上用 draft。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the draw root or the spelling; the near-meaning group compares words for preliminary versions.
note.cn: 形近组共享「拉」的词根或拼写；近义组比较表示「初步版本」的词。

entries.definition: The British spelling, used for air currents and drinks.
entries.definitionCN: 英式拼写，多用于气流与饮品义，与 draft 同源。

entries.definition: To make a picture with lines, or to pull something toward you.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「画；拉」，是 draft 的远亲基础词。

entries.definition: A person who writes the first version of a document.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「起草人」，由 draft 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: A short plan showing main points only.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「提纲」，只列要点，比 draft 更简。

entries.definition: A quick rough drawing or description.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「速写、粗略描述」，强调快速而非完整。

entries.definition: One form of a text among several revisions.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「版本」，指多次修改中的一个形态。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the pulling image behind draw and the split between draft and draught.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着 draw 背后的「拉」意象，以及 draft 与 draught 的分工展开。

normal.en: Dragan meant to pull, and a draft is what you pull out of your mind first.
normal.cn: dragan 意为「拉」，草稿就是你最先从脑子里拉出来的那部分。

normal.en: British air is a draught, American air is a draft, but the origin is one word.
normal.cn: 英式写 draught 表示气流，美式写 draft，但源头是同一个词。

normal.en: A bank draft pulls money out of an account on paper.
normal.cn: bank draft 是用一张纸把钱从账户里拉出来。

normal.en: To draft a soldier is to pull him out of civilian life.
normal.cn: draft 一个士兵，就是把他从平民生活中拉走。

normal.en: Redraft simply means draw the whole thing again.
normal.cn: redraft 就是「把整篇再画一遍」。

abstract.en: Picture a page covered with arrows and crossed-out lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸，满是箭头和划掉的句子。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain moving at the edge of a door.
abstract.cn: 想象门缝边轻轻摆动的窗帘。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pulling a sheet from a stack of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从一摞纸里抽出最上面一张。

examples.en: The lawyer drafted a new contract for the deal.
examples.cn: 律师为这笔交易起草了一份新合同。

examples.en: Her second draft was much shorter than the first.
examples.cn: 她的第二稿比第一稿短得多。

examples.en: A draft blew through the open window all night.
examples.cn: 整夜都有风从敞开的窗户灌进来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抓夫特」——把壮丁抓去当兵（draft），也把脑子里的想法抓出来写成草稿。

root: 与 draught 同源，源自中古英语 draught（拉、画），再往上追溯至古英语 dragan（拉、拖、画），与现代 draw 同源。由「拉出、画出」引申为「草稿、草案、汇票」，由「拉动的气流」引申为「穿堂风」，由「把人拉走」引申为「征召」。

sensesIntro.en: One pulling motion produces written early versions, payment orders, air currents and conscripted soldiers.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个「拉」的动作，生出文字初稿、付款指令、气流与征兵四类用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet pulled out of a stack, still covered in corrections.
core.cn: 核心意象：从一摞纸里抽出来的一页，上面满是涂改。

branches.en: TEXT: the early version and the act of making it are the noun and verb of one outline.
branches.cn: 文字线：初稿与起草动作，是同一份框架的名词与动词，即第一、五个义项。

branches.en: PLANS: budgets and agreements also begin as drawn outlines.
branches.cn: 计划线：预算与协议同样从画出的框架开始，即第二个义项。

branches.en: MONEY: a payment order is a document drawn on an account.
branches.cn: 金钱线：付款指令是从账户里画出的一纸文书，即第三个义项。

branches.en: AIR: moving air is literally pulled through a gap.
branches.cn: 气流线：流动的空气正是被从缝隙里拉进来的，即第四个义项。

branches.en: PEOPLE: conscription pulls a person out of ordinary life.
branches.cn: 人员线：征兵把人从平常生活中拉走，即第六个义项。

intro.en: Draft is a whole English word, but it still takes ordinary English affixes freely.
intro.cn: draft 是完整的英语词，但仍可自由地接普通英语词缀。

latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语祖先；dragan 属日耳曼语，与 draw 同源。

items.example: British usage keeps draught for air.

definition_zh: n. 绘图员；起草人；素描画师
definition_en: a person who makes technical drawings, writes a first version of a document, or works in drawing
core_image: 制图桌上摊着蓝图，丁字尺与圆规压住纸角，一只手握着铅笔沿尺边画线；另一桌上一份法案初稿被红笔改满
scene: 制图桌上摊着蓝图，丁字尺压住纸角，绘图员沿尺边一笔笔画出零件的轮廓。The draftsman ruled the last line and signed the drawing.
sceneCN: 这里 draftsman 是「绘图员」（第 1 个义项：为机器或建筑绘制详细技术图纸的人）；句意是绘图员画完最后一条线并在图纸上签名。图中可辨识物件：蓝图、丁字尺、圆规、铅笔、签名栏。

pos.zh: 绘图员；起草人；素描画师

senses.title: Technical drawer
senses.definition: a person who makes detailed technical drawings of machines or buildings
senses.definitionCN: （名词）为机器或建筑绘制详细技术图纸的人
senses.example: The draftsman ruled the last line and signed the drawing.
senses.exampleCN: 绘图员画完最后一条线并在图纸上签名。
senses.why: A blueprint on a table with a T-square holding the corner while a pencil follows the edge.
senses.whyCN: 桌上摊着蓝图，丁字尺压住纸角，铅笔沿尺边走。

senses.title: Writer of a first version
senses.definition: a person who writes the first version of a document or bill
senses.definitionCN: （名词）撰写文件或法案初稿的人
senses.example: He was the chief draftsman of the new law.
senses.exampleCN: 他是这部新法律的主要起草人。
senses.why: A page of a bill covered in red corrections beside a fresh pencil.
senses.whyCN: 一页法案被红笔改满，旁边放着一支新铅笔。

senses.title: Artist in pencil
senses.definition: an artist who works in drawing rather than paint
senses.definitionCN: （名词）以素描而非油画创作的艺术家
senses.example: The gallery called him a fine draftsman.
senses.exampleCN: 画廊称他为出色的素描画师。
senses.why: A sheet of paper filled with silverpoint lines and no colour at all.
senses.whyCN: 一张纸画满银尖笔线条，完全没有颜色。

intro.en: Draftsman is draft plus man, the man who makes a draft; draft and draw share the same Old English drag root, so a draftsman is literally one who pulls lines across paper. British English keeps the older spelling draughtsman.
intro.cn: draftsman 由 draft 加 man 组成，做出草稿的人；draft 与 draw 共用同一个古英语「拉」词根，所以 draftsman 字面上就是把线条拉过纸面的人。英式英语保留较旧的拼写 draughtsman。

items.en: Old English dragan means to draw or drag.
items.cn: 古英语 dragan 意为拉、拖。

items.en: Middle English draught names a pulling or a thing drawn.
items.cn: 中古英语 draught 指一次拉动或被画出的东西。

items.en: English draft comes to name a first version of a text.
items.cn: 英语 draft 转而指文本的初稿。

items.en: Draughtsman is recorded for a person who draws plans.
items.cn: draughtsman 被记录下来，指绘制图纸的人。

items.en: American English simplifies the spelling to draftsman.
items.cn: 美式英语把拼写简化为 draftsman。

items.en: The word covers technical drawing and the writing of bills.
items.cn: 这个词涵盖技术制图与法案起草。

note.en: Draftsman is the man who makes a draft; its look-alikes share draft or man, and its neighbours name other people who draw or write plans.
note.cn: draftsman 是做出草稿的人；形近词共用 draft 或 man，近义词则是别的画图或写方案的人。

definition_zh: n. 蜻蜓；空中猎手；蜻蜓纹样

core_image: 一只长身四翼的蜻蜓悬停在芦苇上方，透明翅脉像细网，复眼占满头部；泥里稚虫弹出可折叠的下唇；一枚展翅的珐琅胸针

pos.zh: 蜻蜓；空中猎手；蜻蜓纹样

senses.title: The insect
senses.definition: a flying insect with a long thin body and two pairs of clear wings that can hover and fly backwards
senses.definitionCN: （名词）身体细长、有两对透明翅膀、能悬停也能倒飞的昆虫
senses.example: A dragonfly hovered over the reeds and then darted away.
senses.exampleCN: 一只蜻蜓在芦苇上方悬停，随后疾飞而去。
senses.why: A long-bodied insect hanging still above reeds, four clear wings veined like net.
senses.whyCN: 一只长身昆虫静止悬在芦苇上方，四片透明翅的翅脉像网。

senses.title: An aerial hunter
senses.definition: the same insect in its role as a predator that catches mosquitoes in flight
senses.definitionCN: （名词）同一种昆虫作为在空中捕食蚊类的捕食者
senses.example: A single dragonfly can clear a pond of mosquitoes.
senses.exampleCN: 一只蜻蜓就能把池塘里的蚊子清掉。
senses.why: A basket formed by six legs scooping a midge out of the air.
senses.whyCN: 六条腿围成的篮子从空中兜住一只蠓。

senses.title: A decorative motif
senses.definition: a dragonfly used as a design in jewellery or painting

intro.en: Dragonfly is dragon plus fly, a fly as fierce as a dragon; the name appeared in the 17th century, replacing older English words such as adderbolt and horse-stinger, and it reflects the insect as a ruthless hunter rather than any fire.
intro.cn: dragonfly 由 dragon 加 fly 组成，像龙一样凶的蝇；这个名字出现在 17 世纪，取代了 adderbolt 一类旧英语词，它反映的是这种昆虫作为无情猎手的一面，与火无关。

items.en: Old English fleoge means a fly.

items.en: The dragonfly becomes a favourite motif in jewellery.
items.cn: 蜻蜓成为首饰中常见的纹样。

definition_zh: 排水；流干；排水沟；下水道；耗尽；流失
definition_en: to make liquid flow away, or a pipe or channel that carries waste water away
core_image: 水池底部的旋涡，把所有水都吸下去
scene: 厨房水槽堵了，脏水漫过池沿，地面一片湿滑。He had to drain the sink before fixing the pipe.
sceneCN: 这里 drain 是「把水排掉」（第 1 个义项）；句意是他得先把水槽里的水排掉才能修管道。

pos.zh: 排掉（液体）；使流干
流走；逐渐减少
排水沟；下水道；消耗

senses.title: To make liquid flow away
senses.definition: to remove water or another liquid from something by letting it flow out
senses.definitionCN: 让水或其他液体流出去，从而把它从某物中清除
senses.example: Drain the rice and leave it to cool.
senses.exampleCN: 把米沥干，放凉。
senses.why: The word descends from a Germanic root meaning to make dry, so its first job is simply to take liquid away.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自表示「使干」的日耳曼词根，所以它最初的工作就是把液体带走。

senses.title: To flow away gradually
senses.definition: to flow out slowly until little or nothing is left
senses.definitionCN: 慢慢流出去，直到所剩无几
senses.example: The flood water drained away overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水一夜之间退去了。
senses.why: When the object is the liquid itself rather than a container, the same action becomes an intransitive flowing away.
senses.whyCN: 当对象是液体本身而不是容器时，同一个动作就变成不及物的「流走」。

senses.title: A channel that carries waste water
senses.definition: a pipe or open channel that carries away waste water or rainwater
senses.definitionCN: 把污水或雨水送走的管道或明沟
senses.example: Leaves blocked the drain outside the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 落叶堵住了门外的排水沟。
senses.why: The thing that performs the draining takes the action's name, so the channel itself is called a drain.
senses.whyCN: 执行「排」这个动作的装置沿用了动作的名称，于是排水沟本身也叫 drain。

senses.title: To use up strength or money
senses.definition: to take away someone's energy, money, or resources until little is left
senses.definitionCN: 把某人的精力、金钱或资源抽走，直到所剩无几
senses.example: The long illness drained the family's savings.
senses.exampleCN: 这场漫长的病耗尽了家里的积蓄。
senses.why: Energy and money behave like liquid in this metaphor: they can be drawn out until the container is empty.
senses.whyCN: 在这个比喻里，精力与金钱就像液体，可以被抽走，直到容器见底。

senses.title: A steady loss of something valuable
senses.definition: a continuous loss of people, skills, or money from a place or system
senses.definitionCN: 人员、技能或资金从一个地方或体系中持续流失
senses.example: The countryside suffers from a steady drain of young workers.
senses.exampleCN: 乡村正承受年轻劳动力持续外流的压力。
senses.why: If draining empties a container drop by drop, the noun also names that slow emptying of a whole region.
senses.whyCN: 如果排水是一滴一滴把容器放空，那么这个名词也指一整个地区被慢慢抽空的过程。

intro.en: Drain comes from Old English drehnian, to strain or draw off liquid, and its family is Germanic.
intro.cn: drain 来自古英语 drehnian，意为「滤出、抽走液体」，其词族属日耳曼语。

items.en: A root meaning to make dry or to strain lies behind the English word; the exact shape is reconstructed.
items.cn: 英语这个词背后有一个表示「使干、过滤」的词根，其确切形态是重构出来的。

items.en: Drehnian meant to strain liquid off or to draw it away.
items.cn: drehnian 意为把液体滤出或抽走。

items.en: The verb settled as drayne and extended from kitchens to fields and mines.
items.cn: 动词固定为 drayne，并从厨房扩展到田地与矿井。

items.en: The noun appeared for the channel that carries water away; the earliest examples are roughly dated.
items.cn: 名词出现，指把水送走的沟渠；最早用例的年代只能大致推定。

items.en: The liquid image spread to energy, savings, and the loss of skilled people from a region.
items.cn: 液体的意象扩展到精力、积蓄，以及一个地区技术人才的外流。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stem; the near-meaning group separates removing liquid from using it up.
note.cn: 形近组共享词干；近义组把「排出液体」与「耗光」分开。

entries.definition: Extremely tired, as if emptied of energy.

entries.definition: To use something up completely, especially resources or energy.

entries.definition: An underground pipe for waste water and sewage.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「下水道」，规模比 drain 更大、更专门。

normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着液体的意象，从水槽一路走到人才外流的地区。

normal.en: Drain and dry share a meaning, so the word is about removing wetness.
normal.cn: drain 与 dry 意义相通，这个词的核心就是「去湿」。

normal.en: A drain is simply the thing that does the draining.
normal.cn: drain 这个装置，就是执行「排」这个动作的东西。

normal.en: Energy drains like water, which is why tired people feel drained.
normal.cn: 精力像水一样流走，所以累坏的人会觉得被抽空了。

normal.en: Brain drain means the cleverest people flow out of a country.
normal.cn: brain drain 指最聪明的人像水一样流出国外。

normal.en: A drain on resources is a slow leak you keep paying for.
normal.cn: a drain on resources 就是一处你不断为之付钱的慢性漏水。

abstract.cn: 想象排水口上方转起的旋涡。

abstract.en: Picture a bathtub slowly emptying after the plug is pulled.

examples.cn: 加酱之前请先把面里的水沥干。

examples.en: The drain in the yard is blocked again.
examples.cn: 院子里的排水沟又堵了。

examples.en: Endless paperwork drained her energy.
examples.cn: 没完没了的文书工作耗尽了她的精力。

sensesIntro.cn: 「水离开容器」这一个画面，长出了管道、疲惫与地区性流失。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whirlpool pulling every drop down a plug hole.
core.cn: 核心意象：旋涡把每一滴水都吸进排水口。

branches.en: WATER: the verb works both on the container and on the liquid itself.
branches.cn: 水线：这个动词既能作用在容器上，也能作用在液体本身上，即第一、二个义项。

branches.en: THE PIPE: the device that drains takes the action's name.
branches.cn: 管道线：执行排水动作的装置沿用了动作之名，即第三个义项。

branches.en: THE BODY: strength and money can be poured out like water.
branches.cn: 身体线：体力与金钱可以像水一样被倒空，即第四个义项。

branches.en: THE REGION: a place slowly empties of its skilled people.
branches.cn: 地区线：一个地方慢慢被抽走它的技术人才，即第五个义项。

branches.en: Draining a sink and draining a person share the same emptying motion.
branches.cn: 把水槽排空与把人耗空，共享同一个「倒空」的动作。

definition_zh: 排水；排水系统；排出的水；流域；引流
definition_en: the system or process by which water is removed from land, soil or a wound
core_image: 一片积水的田里，几条暗沟把水引向低处的河，水面一寸寸退下去
scene: 暴雨过后，低洼的农田积起半尺深的水，田垄间几条暗沟正把浑水引向旁边的河。Faulty drainage left the lower fields under water for a week.
sceneCN: 这里 drainage 指「排水系统、排水设施」（第 1 个义项：把地表或土壤中的水引走的沟渠与管网）；句意为排水系统出了故障，低处的田地积水达一周之久。

pos.zh: 排水；排水系统；排出的水；（医学）引流

senses.title: The system that carries water away
senses.titleCN: 排水系统：把水引走的整套设施
senses.definition: the network of ditches, pipes and channels that removes water from an area
senses.definitionCN: 把水从某地引走的沟渠、管道与渠道系统
senses.example: Faulty drainage left the lower fields under water for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 排水系统出了故障，低处的田地积水达一周之久。
senses.why: drainage is drain plus -age, and -age names a process or the whole apparatus that carries it out; the village owns not one ditch but a connected set of them.
senses.whyCN: drainage 是 drain 加 -age，而 -age 表示过程或执行该过程的整套装置；村子拥有的不是一条沟，而是一组相连的沟渠。

senses.title: The act of draining water off
senses.titleCN: 排水过程：把水排走这件事
senses.definition: the process of removing surplus water from soil, land or a structure
senses.definitionCN: 把多余的水从土壤、土地或建筑物中排走的过程
senses.example: Good drainage keeps the clay soil workable after heavy rain.
senses.exampleCN: 排水良好能让黏土在暴雨后仍然可耕。
senses.why: the same suffix names the action itself, so the word can refer to what is done rather than to the works that do it.
senses.whyCN: 同一个后缀也命名动作本身，因此这个词可以指「排水这件事」，而不是干这件事的设施。

senses.title: Water that has been drained away
senses.titleCN: 排出的水：被引走的液体
senses.definition: the water, often waste water, that is carried off by drains
senses.definitionCN: 被排水设施引走的水，常指污水
senses.example: The drainage from the mine carried heavy metals into the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 矿井排出的水把重金属带进了小溪。
senses.why: by metonymy the container word comes to name its contents: what the drains carry is also called drainage.
senses.whyCN: 通过转喻，容器之名转而指其中的内容：排水设施所输送的水也被叫作 drainage。

senses.title: The land area that sends water to a river
senses.titleCN: 流域：把水汇给某条河的地面
senses.definition: the whole area whose surface water flows into a particular river or basin
senses.definitionCN: 地表水全部流入某条河或某个盆地的整个区域
senses.example: The drainage of the upper valley feeds three reservoirs.
senses.exampleCN: 上谷的集水区供养着三座水库。
senses.why: hydrologists speak of what a river drains, so drainage shifts from the channel to the land that supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 水文学家谈「一条河排走哪片地面的水」，于是 drainage 从河道转到供养它的土地。

senses.title: How readily soil lets water through
senses.titleCN: 土壤排水性：水通过的快慢
senses.definition: the rate at which water moves down through soil or rock
senses.definitionCN: 水在土壤或岩层中向下移动的速率
senses.example: Heavy clay has poor drainage and stays wet for days.
senses.exampleCN: 重黏土的排水性差，会连续几天保持潮湿。
senses.why: a soil is judged by how fast it drains, so the abstract noun names a property of the ground rather than a structure.
senses.whyCN: 人们用「水排得多快」来评价土壤，因此这个抽象名词指的是地面的一种性质，而非某种结构。

senses.title: Medical drainage of a wound
senses.titleCN: 医学引流：把伤口液体引走
senses.definition: the removal of fluid from a wound or body cavity, or the fluid so removed
senses.definitionCN: 把液体从伤口或体腔引出，或指这样引出的液体
senses.example: The nurse checked the drainage from the wound each morning.
senses.exampleCN: 护士每天早上检查伤口的引流液。
senses.why: medicine applies the same image to the body: fluid is given a path out, and the word names both the procedure and its product.
senses.whyCN: 医学把同一意象用到身体上：给液体一条出路，这个词既指操作也指引出的东西。

senses.title: Pumping water out of a mine or tunnel
senses.definition: the removal of ground water from a mine, tunnel or construction pit
senses.definitionCN: 从矿井、隧道或施工基坑中抽走地下水
senses.example: Mine drainage must be pumped out before the shaft can be deepened.
senses.exampleCN: 在加深竖井之前，必须先把矿井积水抽走。
senses.why: the engineering sense narrows the general idea to water that must be lifted out of a hole, because gravity will not do the work.
senses.whyCN: 工程义把一般概念收窄为「必须从坑里提上来的水」，因为重力无法把它带走。

senses.title: A steady loss of people or resources
senses.titleCN: 资源与人力的持续外流
senses.definition: a continuing loss of people, money or resources from a place or system
senses.definitionCN: 人、资金或资源从一个地方或系统中持续流失
senses.example: The drainage of trained nurses to big cities weakened the rural clinic.
senses.exampleCN: 受训护士流向大城市，削弱了乡村诊所。
senses.why: the metaphor treats a community as ground that loses its water through channels, leaving it dry.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把社区当作会沿沟渠失水的地面，水流走之后只剩干涸。

intro.en: Drainage is the native verb drain plus the noun suffix -age. Drain goes back to Old English dreahnian 'to strain out, draw off liquid', and -age reached English through Old French from Latin -aticum. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: drainage 是英语本族动词 drain 加名词后缀 -age 构成。drain 上承古英语 dreahnian「沥出、滤干液体」；-age 经古法语来自拉丁 -aticum。年代均为约数。

items.en: Dreahnian meant to strain or draw off liquid, and was used of a wound, a vessel or wet ground. The modern verb drain shortened both the vowel and the ending.
items.cn: dreahnian 意为沥出、引流液体，用于伤口、容器或潮湿地面。现代动词 drain 缩短了元音与词尾。

items.en: By the fourteenth century drainen is recorded for emptying a pond or a ditch. The noun drain, meaning a channel, appears later, in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 到 14 世纪，drainen 已用于排空池塘或沟渠。表示通道的名词 drain 出现较晚，在 16 世纪。

items.en: The suffix -age entered English with Old French, from Latin -aticum, which formed nouns of action or collective status; attached to a verb it names the process or the set of works.
items.cn: 后缀 -age 随古法语进入英语，源自拉丁 -aticum，用来构成动作或集合状态的名词；接在动词后即命名过程或整套设施。

items.en: The noun drainage is recorded in the seventeenth century in writing on fen reclamation and water meadow management.
items.cn: 名词 drainage 在 17 世纪见于沼泽开垦与草甸灌溉管理的文献。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word covers urban sewerage, mine dewatering and the drainage basin as a unit of land.
items.cn: 19 世纪，这个词覆盖城市排污、矿井排水以及作为土地单元的流域。

items.en: Source uncertain: the deeper origin of drain is not settled; a link with Old English drygan 'to dry' is often proposed but not demonstrated, and the first dates above are approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根存疑）：drain 的更深来源没有定论；把它与古英语 drygan「使干」相联系的说法常被提出，但未获证实；上述首见年代也只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds water-handling words that are constantly swapped; group two holds the terms for the land area that feeds a river.
note.cn: 第一组是常被互换的水利词汇；第二组是命名「供养一条河的地面」的术语。

entries.definition: A single pipe or ditch that carries water away; drainage is the whole arrangement of such channels.
entries.definitionCN: 单条把水引走的管或沟；drainage 则是这类通道的整套安排。

entries.definition: An underground conduit built for sewage; drainage may also carry clean rain water.
entries.definitionCN: 专为污水建的地下管道；排水系统也可能输送干净的雨水。

entries.definition: Water that flows over the surface instead of entering the soil; drainage is what removes it.
entries.definitionCN: 未渗入土壤而在地表流走的水；排水系统负责把它引走。

entries.definition: Bringing water to land on purpose; drainage takes water away from it.
entries.definitionCN: 有意把水送到土地上；排水则把水从土地上带走。

entries.definition: The area from which rain and streams feed one river or reservoir.
entries.definitionCN: 雨水与小河汇入同一条河或同一水库的区域。

entries.definition: Either the dividing ridge between basins or, in North American usage, the basin itself.
entries.definitionCN: 既可指流域之间的分水岭，也可在北美用法中指流域本身。

entries.definition: A river, stream or artificial channel through which water flows.
entries.definitionCN: 水流经的河、溪或人工渠道。

entries.definition: The point or amount at which water leaves a lake, basin or system.
entries.definitionCN: 水离开湖泊、盆地或系统的出口或数量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real suffixes, real compounds and real collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的后缀、复合词与固定搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: drain + -age: the -age noun names what the verb does, as in seepage and leakage.
normal.cn: drain + -age：-age 名词命名动词所做的事，如 seepage、leakage。

normal.en: A drainage basin is not a basin you wash in: it is the land that drains into one river.
normal.cn: drainage basin 不是洗脸的盆，而是把水排入同一条河的土地。

normal.en: The word covers both the ditches and the water in them, as printing can mean the act and the product.
normal.cn: 这个词既指沟渠也指沟里的水，正如 printing 既可指印刷行为也可指印刷品。

normal.en: Medical drainage uses the same picture: fluid is shown a way out of the body.
normal.cn: 医学引流用同一幅画面：给液体一条离开身体的出路。

normal.en: Poor drainage is a soil property; blocked drainage is a broken system. The context tells you which reading is meant.
normal.cn: poor drainage 说的是土壤性质，blocked drainage 说的是系统堵塞；上下文决定读法。

abstract.en: A city without drainage is a city that keeps every storm it has ever met.
abstract.cn: 没有排水系统的城市，会把遇到过的每一场暴雨都留在原地。

abstract.en: When talented people leave a region, economists borrow the word and call it a drainage of talent.
abstract.cn: 人才离开某地时，经济学家借用这个词，称之为人才的流失。

abstract.en: A good conversation has drainage too: small channels that let pressure out before it floods.
abstract.cn: 好的对话也有排水：细小的通道让压力在泛滥之前先泄出去。

examples.en: The new drainage system carries rainwater away from the market.
examples.cn: 新的排水系统把雨水从市场引走。

examples.en: Poor drainage turns the path into mud after every storm.
examples.cn: 排水不良使小路每场暴雨后都变成泥浆。

examples.en: Engineers mapped the drainage of the whole valley before building the dam.
examples.cn: 工程师在筑坝前测绘了整个山谷的集水区。

dict_mnemonic.text: drain（排走）+ -age（过程、集合）＝把水引走的整套安排；沟渠、管网、流域都归到「水往哪里走」这一条线。

root: 由动词 drain（排走液体）加后缀 -age（过程、集合）构成；drain 上承古英语 dreahnian「沥出、滤干」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of drainage. The core is a path given to water: first the works, then the act, then the water itself, then the land that supplies it, and finally any steady outflow.
sensesIntro.cn: drainage 的八个义项。核心是「给水一条路」：先是设施，再是动作，再是被引走的水，再是供养它的土地，最后是任何持续的外流。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water is given a path and led away from where it is not wanted.
core.cn: 核心意象：给水一条路，把它从不需要它的地方引走。

branches.en: WORKS AND ACT: the connected channels, then the process they perform.
branches.cn: 设施与动作：先是相连的通道，再是它们执行的过程。

branches.en: WHAT MOVES AND WHERE FROM: the water carried off, then the land that supplies it.
branches.cn: 流动之物与来源：先是被引走的水，再是供养它的土地。

branches.en: A PROPERTY OF GROUND: how fast soil lets water pass, with no pipe in sight.
branches.cn: 地面的性质：土壤让水通过得多快，此时并不需要管道。

branches.en: REMOVAL BY FORCE OR BY DESIGN: fluid drawn from a wound, water pumped from a mine.
branches.cn: 借力或设计而成的排出：从伤口引出液体，从矿井抽水。

branches.en: OUTFLOW AS LOSS: people and money leaving a place are treated as water leaving dry land.
branches.cn: 外流即流失：人与钱离开某地，被当作水离开干地。

intro.en: Drainage is drain plus -age. The suffix, not the root, is the borrowed element: -age turns the verb into the name of a process and of the apparatus that performs it.
intro.cn: drainage 由 drain 加 -age 构成。借来的是后缀而非词根：-age 把动词变成过程之名，也变成执行该过程的装置之名。

latinIntro.en: Drain itself is a Germanic word with no Latin cognate. Only the suffix is Latin in origin, coming through French from -aticum; Latin ripa and the drain family are unrelated.
latinIntro.cn: drain 本身是日耳曼语词，没有拉丁同族词。只有后缀源自拉丁，经法语来自 -aticum；拉丁 ripa 与 drain 词族无关。

items.example: The farmer drained the field before sowing.
items.exampleCN: 农夫在播种前把田里的水排干。

items.meaning: process, state or a collective set
items.example: Drainage, seepage and leakage all name processes.

items.meaning: a channel or pipe that carries liquid away
items.example: A drain runs along the edge of the road.

items.meaning: a device or person that drains
items.example: She lifted the drainer out of the sink.
items.exampleCN: 她把沥水架从水槽里拿起来。

items.example: He felt drained after the long shift.
items.exampleCN: 长时间值班后他感到精疲力竭。

items.meaning: the act of removing liquid; exhausting
items.example: Draining the pond took two days.

items.meaning: the land area drained by one river system
items.meaningCN: 由同一河系排水的陆地区域
items.example: The city lies inside the drainage basin of the Yangtze.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市位于长江流域之内。

items.meaning: a pipe that carries waste water away
items.example: A broken drainpipe flooded the basement.
items.exampleCN: 一根破损的排水管淹了地下室。

definition_zh: 戏剧；剧本；戏剧性事件；戏剧艺术
definition_en: a play written for the stage, or an exciting and emotional situation
core_image: 舞台上一束追光，把人的一举一动放大
scene: 剧场里灯光渐暗，幕布缓缓拉开，观众屏住呼吸。She studied drama at a small college in the north.
sceneCN: 这里 drama 是「戏剧（学科、艺术形式）」（第 1 个义项）；句意是她在北方一所小学校学习戏剧。

pos.zh: 戏剧；剧本；戏剧性事件

senses.title: The art of writing and performing plays
senses.definition: the art form of plays, or the study of writing and performing them
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧这一艺术形式，或对编剧与表演的学习
senses.example: He teaches drama at a secondary school.
senses.exampleCN: 他在一所中学教戏剧。
senses.why: Greek drama meant a deed or an action performed, so the art form is named after things being done on stage.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 drama 意为「被做的事、行动」，所以这种艺术形式是以「舞台上被做出来的事」命名的。

senses.title: A play or a serious television story
senses.definition: a single play, or a serious story broadcast on television
senses.definitionCN: 一部戏剧作品，或电视上播出的严肃故事
senses.example: The new drama about village life won several awards.
senses.exampleCN: 那部关于乡村生活的新剧拿了好几个奖。
senses.why: One performed action becomes a countable work, so a single play is also called a drama.
senses.whyCN: 一次被演出的行动变成一个可数的作品，所以单部戏也叫 drama。

senses.title: An exciting or tense situation
senses.definition: a situation full of emotion, conflict, or unexpected events
senses.definitionCN: 充满情绪、冲突或意外事件的局面
senses.example: There was some drama at the airport when the flight was cancelled.
senses.exampleCN: 航班取消时，机场里上演了一出闹剧。
senses.why: Real life that looks like a staged action borrows the stage word, so any tense scene becomes drama.
senses.whyCN: 现实生活一旦看起来像被搬上舞台的行动，就借用了舞台的词，于是任何紧张场面都叫 drama。

intro.en: Drama is a direct borrowing from Greek drama, a deed or an action, through Latin and French.
intro.cn: drama 直接借自希腊语 drama（行为、行动），经拉丁语与法语传入英语。

items.en: The verb dran meant to do or to act, and drama was the thing done.
items.cn: 动词 dran 意为「做、行动」，drama 就是「被做出来的事」。

items.en: In Athens drama named a staged action, and by extension a play for the theatre.
items.cn: 在雅典，drama 指被搬上舞台的行动，进而指供剧场演出的戏。

items.en: Latin borrowed the word for plays, keeping the theatrical sense.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个词指戏剧，保留了剧场含义。

items.en: English took the word from Latin and French; the earliest English examples date from the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语与法语借入；最早的英语用例出现在十六世纪。

items.en: The word widened from stage works to television plays and then to any tense real event.
items.cn: 这个词从舞台作品扩展到电视剧，再扩展到任何紧张的真实事件。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Greek root; the near-meaning group gathers related performance words.
note.cn: 形近组共享希腊词根；近义组收的是相关的表演类词汇。

entries.definition: Relating to drama, or sudden and striking.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「戏剧的；戏剧性的」，由 drama 加 -tic 构成。

entries.definition: A person who writes plays.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「剧作家」，由 drama 加 -tist 构成。

entries.definition: To turn a story into a play, or to make it seem more exciting.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「改编成剧；夸大渲染」，由 drama 加 -tize 构成。

entries.definition: A story performed by actors on stage.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「戏剧、剧本」，是最日常的说法。

entries.definition: The building for plays, or the art form as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「剧院；戏剧（整体）」，偏重场所与门类。

entries.definition: A serious play with a sad ending.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「悲剧」，是 drama 的一个具体类型。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the Greek sense of a thing done and follow the word onto television and into daily life.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从希腊语「被做的事」出发，跟着这个词走上电视、走进日常。

normal.en: Dran means to act, so drama is literally the acting.
normal.cn: dran 意为「行动」，所以 drama 字面就是「被演出来的行动」。

normal.en: Dramatic keeps the stage feeling, which is why a dramatic entrance turns heads.
normal.cn: dramatic 保留了舞台感，所以「戏剧性的登场」会让人回头。

normal.en: A dramatist is the person who makes the action happen on paper.
normal.cn: dramatist 就是在纸上让这些行动发生的人。

normal.en: To dramatize a novel is to turn reading into watching.
normal.cn: 把小说 dramatize，就是把「读」变成「看」。

normal.en: When people say there was drama, they mean real life copied the stage.
normal.cn: 人们说「发生了一出戏」，意思是现实生活照搬了舞台。

abstract.en: Picture a spotlight cutting through a dark hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一束追光切进漆黑的大厅。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain rising inch by inch.
abstract.cn: 想象幕布一寸一寸升起。

abstract.en: Picture an audience holding its breath at once.
abstract.cn: 想象满场观众同时屏住呼吸。

examples.en: She has written three radio dramas this year.
examples.cn: 今年她写了三部广播剧。

examples.en: The drama department is putting on a Greek play.
examples.cn: 戏剧系正在排演一出希腊戏。

examples.en: There was a lot of drama before the vote was finally held.
examples.cn: 投票最终举行之前闹出了不少波折。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抓马」——舞台上情节一抓一大把，抓马就是戏多，drama 正是「戏剧、戏多」。

root: 直接借自希腊语 drama（行为、被做的事），源自动词 dran（做、行动），经拉丁语与法语进入英语。因为戏剧就是「把行动演出来」，这个词天然带着「动作、冲突」的意味，后来引申为戏剧性事件。

sensesIntro.en: A performed action becomes an art form, then a countable play, then any tense real scene.
sensesIntro.cn: 被演出的行动先成为艺术门类，再成为可数的作品，最后成为任何紧张的真实场面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spotlight that enlarges every gesture on stage.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束把所有动作都放大的舞台追光。

branches.en: ART: the first sense is the whole craft and its study.
branches.cn: 艺术线：第一个义项是这门技艺及其学科。

branches.en: WORK: a single play or television story is one acting-out of the craft.
branches.cn: 作品线：单部戏或电视剧是这门技艺的一次具体演出，即第二个义项。

branches.en: LIFE: a tense real event borrows the stage word for its own scenes.
branches.cn: 生活线：紧张的真实事件借用了舞台词来描述自己的场面，即第三个义项。

branches.en: The art form and the individual play are the class and its members.
branches.cn: 艺术门类与单部作品，是类别与其成员的关系。

branches.en: A television drama and a dramatic real event both hold an audience's attention.
branches.cn: 电视剧与戏剧性的真实事件，都能牢牢抓住观众的注意力。

intro.en: Drama is a borrowed stem that takes several Greek-derived English endings.
intro.cn: drama 是借来的词干，能接几个经希腊语而来的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin drama is recorded, but the word is originally Greek and reached English through French as well.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 drama 有记录，但这个词原本是希腊语，也经法语传入英语。

items.example: The verb is the root of drama.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是 drama 的词根。
这个名词原样进入英语。

items.example: Theatre names the building and the field.

derivatives.zh: 由 drama 加 -tic 构成，义为「戏剧的；戏剧性的」
由 drama 加 -tist 构成，义为「剧作家」

definition_zh: 戏剧的；戏剧性的；显著的；夸张的
definition_en: relating to drama, or sudden, striking, and full of strong feeling
core_image: 门被推开的一瞬，所有目光都转过去
scene: 会场忽然安静，灯光一转，演讲者从侧门大步走上台。The announcement had a dramatic effect on the crowd.
sceneCN: 这里 dramatic 是「显著的、戏剧性的」（第 2 个义项）；句意是这项宣布对人群产生了显著的影响。

pos.zh: 戏剧的；戏剧性的；显著的；夸张的

senses.title: Relating to plays and acting
senses.definition: connected with plays, acting, or the theatre
senses.definitionCN: 与戏剧、表演或剧院有关的
senses.example: She joined a dramatic society at university.
senses.exampleCN: 她在大学加入了一个戏剧社。
senses.why: The Greek noun drama named a staged action, and the ending -tic simply means belonging to it.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语名词 drama 指被搬上舞台的行动，后缀 -tic 只表示「属于它」，所以这是最本分的义项。

senses.title: Sudden and very noticeable
senses.definition: large, sudden, and easy to notice, especially of a change or an effect
senses.definitionCN: 幅度大、来得突然、很容易被注意到，多形容变化或效果
senses.example: There has been a dramatic fall in prices.
senses.exampleCN: 价格出现了大幅下跌。
senses.why: A change that would look striking on stage is called dramatic, so the word came to mean strikingly large.
senses.whyCN: 一个在舞台上会显得触目惊心的变化，就被称作 dramatic，于是这个词有了「幅度惊人」的意思。

senses.title: Showy and full of strong feeling
senses.definition: expressing feelings in an exaggerated, theatrical way
senses.definitionCN: 以夸张、像演戏一样的方式表达情绪
senses.example: He let out a dramatic sigh and left the room.
senses.exampleCN: 他夸张地叹了口气，走出了房间。
senses.why: When ordinary behaviour copies stage acting, the same adjective describes it as overdone.
senses.whyCN: 当日常举动模仿舞台表演时，同一个形容词就用来形容它「演过头了」。

intro.en: Dramatic is Greek drama plus the adjective ending -tikos, filtered through Latin dramaticus and French dramatique.
intro.cn: dramatic 由希腊语 drama 加形容词词尾 -tikos 构成，经拉丁语 dramaticus 与法语 dramatique 传入英语。

items.en: Dran meant to do or act, and drama was the deed performed.
items.cn: dran 意为「做、行动」，drama 是被做出来的事。

items.en: The adjective meant skilled in acting or belonging to drama.
items.cn: 这个形容词表示「擅长表演的」或「属于戏剧的」。

items.en: Latin kept the adjective for anything connected with plays.
items.cn: 拉丁语保留这个形容词，指与戏剧有关的事物。

items.en: French carried the form toward modern spelling and meaning.
items.cn: 法语把这个形式推向近代拼写与含义。

items.en: English adopted dramatic for stage matters and soon extended it to striking events.
items.cn: 英语采用 dramatic 指舞台事务，很快又扩展到惊人的事件。

items.en: The word now covers theatre, big changes, and exaggerated behaviour.
items.cn: 今天这个词覆盖戏剧、巨大变化与夸张举止三方面。

note.en: The look-alike group is the same family; the near-meaning group compares three words for striking change.
note.cn: 形近组同属一个词族；近义组比较三个表示「变化惊人」的词。

entries.definition: A play, or the art of performing plays.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「戏剧」，是 dramatic 的基础词。

entries.definition: In a striking way, or by a large amount.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「大幅度地；戏剧性地」，由 dramatic 加 -ally 构成。

entries.definition: To adapt for the stage or to exaggerate.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「改编成剧；夸大」，与 dramatic 同族。

entries.definition: Very noticeable and impressive.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「引人注目的」，强调视觉冲击。

entries.definition: Sudden and large, especially of a change.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「急剧的」，多修饰变化的幅度。

entries.definition: Exaggerated in manner, like an actor on stage.

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the stage picture from real theatre to big changes to overacting.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着舞台画面，从真正的戏剧走到巨大变化，再到演过头。

normal.en: Drama plus -tic simply means of the stage.
normal.cn: drama 加 -tic 就是「属于舞台的」。

normal.en: A dramatic rise is a change big enough to look like a scene.
normal.cn: dramatic rise 就是大到像一场戏的变化。

normal.en: Dramatic irony is the audience knowing what the character does not.
normal.cn: dramatic irony 指观众知道而剧中人不知道。

normal.en: A dramatic sigh is acting without a stage.
normal.cn: dramatic sigh 就是没有舞台的表演。

normal.en: Dramatics as a plural noun means either amateur theatre or showy behaviour.
normal.cn: 复数名词 dramatics 既指业余戏剧，也指做作的举止。

abstract.en: Picture a door thrown open and every head turning.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门被推开，所有脑袋同时转过去。

abstract.en: Picture a graph line dropping off the page.
abstract.cn: 想象一条曲线陡降，几乎掉出纸外。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised to the forehead in mock despair.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手按上额头，装作绝望。

examples.en: The city has seen dramatic growth in ten years.
examples.cn: 这座城市十年间出现了惊人的增长。

examples.en: Her dramatic reading held the whole room.
examples.cn: 她富有戏剧感的朗诵镇住了全场。

examples.en: He made a dramatic gesture with his coat and left.
examples.cn: 他夸张地甩了一下外套就走了。

dict_mnemonic.text: drama 是「戏」，-tic 是「……的」，所以 dramatic 是「像戏一样的」：既能指真的戏剧，也能指惊人的变化和夸张的举止。

root: 由希腊语 drama（行为、戏剧）加形容词词尾 -tikos 构成，经拉丁语 dramaticus 与法语 dramatique 进入英语。核心含义始终是「像舞台上那样引人注目」，因此兼指戏剧本身、巨大的变化与夸张的表达。

sensesIntro.en: From the stage the adjective moves to changes that look stage-worthy, then to people who act as if on stage.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个形容词从舞台出发，移向「像戏一样」的变化，再移向「仿佛在台上」的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door thrown open while every head turns.
core.cn: 核心意象：门被推开，所有目光同时转过去。

branches.en: THEATRE: the literal sense belongs to plays and acting.
branches.cn: 剧场线：字面义属于戏剧与表演，即第一个义项。

branches.en: SCALE: a change big enough to stage is described as dramatic.
branches.cn: 幅度线：大到可以搬上舞台的变化，被形容为 dramatic，即第二个义项。

branches.en: MANNER: behaviour that copies stage acting is called dramatic.
branches.cn: 举止线：模仿舞台表演的行为也叫 dramatic，即第三个义项。

branches.en: Real theatre and overacting share the same visible gestures.
branches.cn: 真正的戏剧与做作的举止，共享同一套夸张可见的手势。

branches.en: Both a dramatic fall and a dramatic sigh are meant to be noticed.
branches.cn: 大幅下跌与夸张的叹息，都是为了被人注意到。

senses.definition: very great in degree, so that the change is severe

senses.title: Severe in action

intro.en: Drastic comes from Greek drastikos, effective or active, from dran, to do; a drastic thing is one that actually does something, and because strong action is usually severe the word slid towards extreme and harsh. The same dran root gives drama, a deed done.
intro.cn: drastic 来自希腊语 drastikos「有效的、起作用的」，源自 dran「做」；drastic 的东西是真正做出事来的东西，而强有力的行动往往严厉，于是词义滑向「极端、峻烈」。同一个 dran 词根给出 drama，即被做出的行为。

items.en: Greek dran means to do or act.
items.cn: 希腊语 dran 意为做、行动。

items.en: Greek drastikos means effective or active.
items.cn: 希腊语 drastikos 意为有效的、起作用的。

items.en: Medieval Latin drasticus keeps the sense of acting strongly.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 drasticus 保留强力起作用的意思。

items.en: English uses drastic for a powerful purgative.
items.cn: 英语用 drastic 指作用强烈的泻药。

items.en: The word spreads to any extreme or severe measure.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到任何极端或严厉的措施。

items.en: Drastic now usually describes changes, cuts and action.
items.cn: drastic 现在通常描述变化、削减与行动。

note.en: Drastic is doing something with force; its look-alikes share the Greek do root, and its neighbours name other degrees of severity.
note.cn: drastic 是用力做出事来；形近词共用希腊语「做」词根，近义词则是严厉程度的其他档位。

dict_mnemonic.text: drastic 来自希腊语 dran「做」加 drastikos「起作用的」，就是「真正做出事来的」。能起大作用的东西往往下手重，所以词义变成「激烈的、严厉的、极端的」。同一个 dran 词根还给出 drama（被做出的行为＝戏剧）。副词 drastically 常见于大幅削减一类搭配。旧医学里 drastic 指峻泻药。

root: 希腊语 dran（做）→ drastikos（有效的、起作用的）→ 中世纪拉丁语 drasticus → 英语 drastic（峻烈的；激烈的）

definition_zh: 画；拉；抽；吸引；提取；平局；抽签
definition_en: to make a picture with lines, to pull something, or to attract attention
core_image: 一支笔在纸上划出第一道线
scene: 孩子坐在窗边，把外面的树一棵棵画进本子里。He sat by the window and began to draw the trees outside.
sceneCN: 这里 draw 是「画」（第 1 个义项）；句意是他坐在窗边开始画外面的树。

pos.zh: 画；拉；抽；吸引；提取
打成平局

senses.title: To make a picture with lines
senses.definition: to make a picture or diagram with a pen or pencil
senses.definitionCN: 用笔画出一幅图或示意图
senses.example: She drew a map on the back of an envelope.
senses.exampleCN: 她在信封背面画了一张地图。
senses.why: The oldest sense is to drag a pen across a surface, and the line left behind turns the pulling motion into a picture.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是拖着一支笔划过纸面，留下的线条就把「拖」这个动作变成了一幅画。

senses.title: To pull something toward you
senses.definition: to pull something such as a curtain or a weapon
senses.definitionCN: 拉动窗帘、武器等物体
senses.example: He drew the curtains before turning on the lamp.
senses.exampleCN: 他开灯前先把窗帘拉上。
senses.why: This is the literal pulling action that the whole family of words grew from.
senses.whyCN: 这就是整个词族赖以生长的那个字面动作：用力往回拉。

senses.title: To attract interest or attention
senses.definition: to cause people to look, come, or feel interested
senses.definitionCN: 使人过来、注视或产生兴趣
senses.example: The exhibition drew large crowds all summer.
senses.exampleCN: 整个夏天这个展览吸引了大批观众。
senses.why: People are pulled toward what interests them, so attracting a crowd uses the same pulling verb.
senses.whyCN: 人会被感兴趣的东西「拉」过去，所以吸引人群用的还是同一个「拉」的动词。

senses.title: To take money out of an account
senses.definition: to take money from a bank account or to receive a salary
senses.definitionCN: 从银行账户里取出钱，或领取薪水
senses.example: I need to draw some cash before the shops close.
senses.exampleCN: 我得在商店关门前取点现金。
senses.why: Money is pulled out of an account just as water is pulled from a well, so the verb covers withdrawals.
senses.whyCN: 钱是从账户里被「拉」出来的，就像水从井里被抽出来，所以这个词也覆盖取款。

senses.title: To reach a result after thinking
senses.definition: to form an opinion or conclusion after considering facts
senses.definitionCN: 在考虑事实后形成看法或结论
senses.example: We can draw a clear conclusion from these figures.
senses.exampleCN: 从这些数字里我们可以得出一个清楚的结论。
senses.why: A conclusion is pulled out of scattered facts the way water is drawn from a well, hence the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 结论是从零散事实里被「抽」出来的，正如水从井里被抽出，所以用同一个动词。

senses.title: To end a game with equal scores
senses.definition: to finish a game or match with the same score for both sides
senses.definitionCN: 比赛结束时双方得分相同
senses.example: The two teams drew one all.
senses.exampleCN: 两队一比一战平。
senses.why: When neither side can pull ahead, the contest is level, and the noun draw names that level result.
senses.whyCN: 当任何一方都拉不开差距时，比赛就打平了，名词 draw 正指这个持平的结果。

senses.title: To choose by picking lots
senses.definition: to select someone or something by taking a card or a lot at random
senses.definitionCN: 通过随机抽取签或卡片来选出人或物
senses.example: They drew the names from a hat.
senses.exampleCN: 他们从帽子里抽出名字。
senses.why: A slip is literally pulled out of a container, so random selection is also called drawing.
senses.whyCN: 签是从容器里被实实在在地抽出来的，所以随机抽取也叫 drawing。

intro.en: Draw goes back to Old English dragan, to drag or pull, and the writing sense grew from dragging a pen.
intro.cn: draw 可追溯到古英语 dragan（拖、拉），「画」的义项就来自拖笔的动作。

items.en: The pulling root behind draw is usually reconstructed with the sense of dragging; the exact form is uncertain.
items.cn: draw 背后的「拉」词根一般被重构为带「拖」义的形式，确切形态不确定。

items.en: Dragan meant to drag or pull, and it also covered drawing a line across a surface.
items.cn: dragan 意为「拖、拉」，也涵盖在表面上拖出一道线。

items.en: The past forms drew and drawn settled, and the picture sense became central.
items.cn: 过去式 drew 与过去分词 drawn 固定下来，「画」的义项成为中心。

items.en: The verb extended to pulling money, attracting people and reaching conclusions.
items.cn: 这个动词扩展到取钱、吸引人与得出结论。

items.en: The noun draw appeared for a tied game and for a random selection.
items.cn: 名词 draw 出现，指平局与随机抽取。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stem or the root; the near-meaning group separates sketching from pulling.
note.cn: 形近组共享词干或词根；近义组把「素描」与「拉」分开。

entries.definition: To draw quickly and roughly, without detail.

entries.definition: To move something toward you with force.

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the drag of a pen and the pulls that produced money, crowds and conclusions.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着拖笔的动作，以及由此产生的取钱、聚人、得结论三条线展开。

normal.en: Dragan meant to drag, and a pen dragged across paper leaves a picture.
normal.cn: dragan 意为「拖」，笔在纸上拖过就留下了一幅画。

normal.en: The past forms are drew and drawn, not drawed.
normal.cn: 过去式是 drew，过去分词是 drawn，不是 drawed。

normal.en: Money is drawn out of a bank the way water is drawn from a well.
normal.cn: 钱从银行被取出，就像水从井里被抽出。

normal.en: A crowd is drawn to a good exhibition, pulled by interest.
normal.cn: 人群被好展览吸引过去，是被兴趣拉过去的。

normal.cn: 平局意味着双方持平，因为谁都拉不开差距。

abstract.en: Picture a pencil leaving its first line on blank paper.
abstract.cn: 想象铅笔在空白纸面上留下第一道线。

abstract.en: Picture a rope being hauled out of deep water.
abstract.cn: 想象一根绳子从深水里被拉上来。

abstract.en: Picture two scoreboards frozen at the same number.
abstract.cn: 想象两块记分牌停在同一个数字上。

examples.en: The children drew animals on the pavement.
examples.cn: 孩子们在人行道上画动物。

examples.en: Her speech drew tears from half the room.
examples.cn: 她的演讲让半个会场的人都流了泪。

examples.en: The match ended in a draw after extra time.
examples.cn: 加时赛后比赛以平局收场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「捉」——把视线、把人、把钱都捉过来，就是 draw 的「拉、吸引、取」；笔在纸上捉出一条线，就是「画」。

root: 来自古英语 dragan（拖、拉），与 drag、draught 同源，词根属日耳曼语。由「拖笔划过纸面」得绘画义，由「往回拉」得拉拽义，由「把人拉过来」得吸引义，由「从账户或容器中抽出」得取款、抽签、得结论诸义；比赛打平时双方拉不开差距，故名词 draw 兼指平局。

sensesIntro.en: Every sense of draw is a version of one pull: a pen, a curtain, a crowd, money, a conclusion, a lottery slip, a level score.
sensesIntro.cn: draw 的每个义项都是同一次「拉」的变体：拉笔、拉窗帘、拉人群、拉钱、拉出结论、抽出签、拉平比分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pen dragged across paper, leaving the first line.
core.cn: 核心意象：笔在纸面上拖出第一道线。

branches.en: ART: dragging a pen turns into drawing a picture.
branches.cn: 绘画线：拖笔的动作变成了画图，即第一个义项。

branches.en: PULLING: the literal sense keeps curtains and weapons in view.
branches.cn: 拉拽线：字面义保留在窗帘与武器这类对象上，即第二个义项。

definition_zh: n. 缺点；不利条件；（贸易）退税

senses.why: A customs window handing a stack of duty back across the counter.

intro.en: Drawback is draw plus back, something drawn back; it first named a drawback of duty, money drawn back from the customs, and only later a feature that pulls the value of a thing back down.
intro.cn: drawback 由 draw 加 back 组成，被拉回来的东西；它最初指关税退还，即从海关拉回来的钱，后来才指把某物价值往下拉的特点。

items.en: Old English dragan means to draw or drag.
items.cn: 古英语 dragan 意为拉、拖。

items.en: Old English baec means the back.
items.cn: 古英语 baec 意为背、后面。

items.en: Drawback names a refund of duty on re-exported goods.
items.cn: drawback 指复出口货物的关税退还。

items.en: The word spreads to any hindrance or disadvantage.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到任何障碍或不利之处。

items.en: Drawback is common in reviews of plans and products.
items.cn: drawback 常用于评价方案与产品。

items.en: The trade sense survives but the everyday sense dominates.
items.cn: 贸易义仍在，但日常义占主导。

note.en: Drawback is something drawn back; its look-alikes share draw or back, and its neighbours name other words for a fault or a hindrance.
note.cn: drawback 是被拉回来的东西；形近词共用 draw 或 back，近义词则是别的表示缺陷或障碍的词。

dict_mnemonic.text: drawback ＝ draw（拉）＋ back（回）＝「被拉回来的东西」。最早是海关术语：进口货再出口时把已交的税「拉回来」，即退税。后来泛指把东西的价值往下拉的那一点，也就是缺点、不利条件。同根的 withdraw 是「撤回」，drawbridge 是「吊桥」。

root: 古英语 dragan（拉）＋ baec（背、后）→ 16 世纪 drawback（关税退还）→ 现代 drawback（缺点；不利条件）

definition_zh: n. 恐惧；畏惧；令人害怕的事；（口语）脏辫 v. 畏惧；害怕；担忧
definition_en: a very strong fear of something still to come, or to feel that fear
core_image: 一个人站在紧闭的门前，手悬在门把上不敢按下；日历上那一天被红圈住；镜子旁垂着一束束绳状的头发
scene: 他站在那扇紧闭的门前，手悬在门把上迟迟不敢按下。He stood at the closed door, full of dread, unable to turn the handle.
sceneCN: 这里 dread 是「恐惧」（第 1 个义项：对将要发生之事的极强烈害怕）；句意是他站在紧闭的门前，满心恐惧，转不动门把。图中可辨识物件：紧闭的门、悬在门把上的手、红圈日历、走廊灯。

senses.title: Great fear
senses.definition: a very strong fear of something that is going to happen
senses.definitionCN: （名词）对将要发生之事的极强烈害怕
senses.example: He stood at the closed door, full of dread.
senses.exampleCN: 他站在紧闭的门前，满心恐惧。

senses.title: To fear greatly

senses.exampleCN: 她整整一周都在害怕那次会面。

senses.whyCN: 一本日历上某一天被红圈住，之前的每一天都被划掉。

senses.title: Ropelike hair
senses.definition: hair hanging in thick ropelike strands, in informal use

senses.why: Thick strands of hair hanging like ropes beside a mirror.

intro.en: Dread comes from Old English draedan, to fear, with the prefixed form ondraedan; the noun and verb have stayed together for a thousand years, and the fear they name is always of something still to come.
intro.cn: dread 来自古英语 draedan「害怕」，带前缀的形式是 ondraedan；名词与动词一千年来一直并行，它们所指的恐惧总是针对尚未到来之事。

definition_zh: n. 恍惚；梦幻感；多梦

normalIntro.en: Five pictures of a mind gone soft and far away.
normalIntro.cn: 五个「心神变得柔软而遥远」的画面。

normal.en: A person staring out of a window with eyes fixed on nothing, tea gone cold.
normal.cn: 一个人望着窗外，眼神没有落在任何东西上，茶已凉透。

normal.en: A waveform blurred at the edges under a soft halo of light.
normal.cn: 一段边缘模糊的波形，笼在柔和的光晕里。

normal.en: A notebook by a pillow filled with written dreams, page after page.
normal.cn: 枕边一本记满梦的笔记，一页接一页。

normal.en: A photograph taken through gauze so every edge is soft.
normal.cn: 一张隔着纱拍的照片，每条边都是柔的。

normal.en: A candle flame seen through a fogged window.
normal.cn: 透过起雾的窗看到的一团烛焰。

examples.en: A dreaminess came over him during the long lecture.
examples.cn: 长篇讲座中他陷入了恍惚。

examples.en: There was a dreaminess in her voice that slowed the room.
examples.cn: 她声音里的梦幻感让整个房间慢了下来。

examples.en: The notebook recorded the dreaminess of those weeks.
examples.cn: 那本笔记记下了那几周的多梦。

dict_mnemonic.text: dreaminess ＝ dream（梦）＋ -y（…的）＋ -ness（状态名词后缀）＝「做梦般的状态」。古英语 dream 本指欢乐与音乐，睡中影像的意思来自古诺斯语 draumr。dreamy 是形容词（恍惚的、梦幻的），dreamily 是副词，dreaminess 是名词，既指人的恍惚，也指音乐光线的梦幻感，还指多梦。

root: 古英语 dream（欢乐、音乐）＋ 古诺斯语 draumr（睡中影像）→ 中古英语 drem → dreamy → dreaminess（恍惚；梦幻感）

sensesIntro.en: A mind gone soft: eyes fixed on nothing, a blurred waveform and a notebook full of written dreams.
sensesIntro.cn: 变得柔软的心神：没有落点的眼睛、模糊的波形与记满梦的笔记。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person staring out of a window with eyes fixed on nothing while a waveform blurs under a soft halo
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人望着窗外眼神没有落点，同时一段波形在柔和光晕下变得模糊

branches.en: A mind not attending to the room.
branches.cn: 没有注意房间的心神。

branches.en: The same softness in sound or light.
branches.cn: 声音或光线里的同一种柔软。

branches.en: The habit behind many dreams.
branches.cn: 许多梦背后的习惯。

branches.en: The state inside and the quality outside.
branches.cn: 里面的状态与外面的质感。

branches.en: Both come from a mind that drifts.
branches.cn: 两者都来自飘忽的心神。

intro.en: Dreaminess is dream plus -y plus -ness; the same -ness builds drowsiness, while the Greek roots hypn- and oneir- name sleep and dreams from another direction.
intro.cn: dreaminess 由 dream 加 -y 加 -ness 构成；同一个 -ness 造出 drowsiness，而希腊语词根 hypn- 与 oneir- 从另一个方向指称睡眠与梦。

latinIntro.en: Greek hypnos means sleep and oneiros a dream; Latin somnus means sleep and sopor a deep sleep; nebula means a mist.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 hypnos 意为睡眠，oneiros 意为梦；拉丁语 somnus 意为睡眠，sopor 意为沉睡；nebula 意为雾。

items.meaning: joy, music, later a vision in sleep
